intro: Web hosting, e-commerce, and publishing sectors face a critical threat landscape from WordPress vulnerabilities, with 14 articles published between April 13 and June 21, 2026. The archive covers a severity mix of 5 critical, 4 high, and 5 medium issues, including the critical CVEs CVE-2019-25763 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-4883 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-6433 (CVSS 9.8), alongside medium-severity CVE-2021-47926 and CVE-2021-47927 (both CVSS 6.4). These vulnerabilities affect digital media, digital publishing, and publishing operations globally.
